rules.when: The vision model failed, timed out or returned unusable output. Captured images are kept; a human (or a retry) decides.
No submitted photo was usable for inspection.
Returned item is not the ordered SKU, or the package is empty. Never restocked under the ordered SKU; routed to review as a possible wrong-item / return-abuse case.
Identity could not be established from the evidence.
Condition could not be graded on the published scale.
Condition is Unacceptable and at least one damage finding is severe (unusable, broken, contaminated).
Condition is Unacceptable without severe damage (e.g. needs repair) - no longer listable, recover residual value.

Hygiene-sensitive category (catalogue flag) that is no longer factory-sealed / New. Only sealed hygiene items are restocked; this avoids flipping between 'opened' and 'lightly used', which photos cannot separate reliably.
At least one expected component could not be confirmed present or absent, and none is confirmed missing.
Some parts are confirmed missing and others could not be seen, and the disposition would change depending on whether the unseen parts are present.
A missing component is flagged non-replaceable in the catalogue (the unit cannot be made whole).
Two or more components are missing.
Exactly one replaceable component is missing and the item grades Used - Good or better: replace the part and relist.
Exactly one replaceable component is missing but the item grades Used - Acceptable.
Complete and Used - Like New: restock under the Used - Like New grade.
Complete and Used - Very Good or Used - Good: clean / repackage, then relist under the assigned grade.
